label: explicit_exclusion
rationale: The molecular eligibility expressly excludes clear FET-non-ETS fusions and specifically names EWSR1-WT1. This is an express defining-fusion exclusion, not merely omission of the DSRCT name.
cohort_reconciliation: Both randomized chemotherapy arms share the Ewing-sarcoma pathology and fusion restriction; no separate DSRCT arm or molecular exception is described.
extra_biomarker_requirement: FISH/NGS evidence of Ewing-specific FET breaks is required, but an EWSR1 break alone cannot override the stated EWSR1-WT1 exclusion.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol is unreviewed. Saved status is NOT_YET_RECRUITING with verification July 2025; elapsed estimated start dates are not evidence recruitment began.
quotes: This study does not impose special restrictions on fusion partner genes, but clear FET-non ETS fusions (such as EWSR1-WT1, EWSR1-NFATC2, EWSR1-PATZ1, etc.) do not meet the enrollment criteria.

label: explicit_exclusion
rationale: This is a clearly closed incompatible positive disease list: first-recurrence grade 4 glioblastoma/other grade 4 malignant glioma or molecular GBM. DSRCT is not an eligible disease class under that list. The WT-1 fusion protein is the investigational product, not a tumor-fusion inclusion rule.
cohort_reconciliation: The safety lead-in and expansion are both within the same recurrent-GBM treatment study, with no open solid-tumor or DSRCT cohort. Gliosarcoma is expressly excluded as well.
extra_biomarker_requirement: HLA-A*0201 is required for the admitted glioma population and is not established by DSRCT; it does not broaden the disease list.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol and live enrollment are unverified; label concerns the saved closed disease scope, not an individual with a second diagnosis. No WT1-expression or therapeutic-fusion match is inferred.
quotes: Have histologically confirmed World Health Organization (WHO) Grade 4 glioblastoma, other WHO grade 4 malignant glioma or molecular GBM (based on the 2021 WHO Classification) at first recurrence. Patients with gliosarcoma are NOT eligible;
A WT-1-pHLA-IL2-Fc fusion protein, single-use vial, via intravenous (into the vein) infusion per protocol.

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: Reference-pathology-confirmed DSRCT is explicitly admitted. High SSTR2/3/5 mRNA expression measured through specified programs is an additional unestablished gate.
cohort_reconciliation: The single maintenance-therapy arm includes DSRCT and synovial sarcoma. Eligibility states DSRCT in any stage while design and narrative emphasize advanced/metastatic disease; retain that scope discrepancy. Recruitment in adolescents follows feasibility assessment in at least three adults, and release of that condition is unknown.
extra_biomarker_requirement: High SSTR2/3/5 mRNA expression by RNA sequencing in MASTER or INFORM is required. The saved record does not supply a numeric high-expression cutoff or establish a patient's result.
protocol_uncertainty: Maintenance requires stable disease/response after standard therapy, no curative option, age 13–50 and a short interval after chemotherapy, plus other criteria. External medication Table 5 and protocol are unreviewed. Overall RECRUITING does not establish adolescent enrollment availability or resolve stage wording.
quotes: Reference pathological proven diagnosis of DSRCT in any stage; or Reference pathological proven diagnosis of SySa, IRS III, metastatic or relapsed disease
High SSTR2/3/5 mRNA expression, as determined by RNA sequencing in the DKFZ/NCT/DKTK MASTER (ClinicalTrials.gov ID: NCT05852522) or INFORM programs.
According to the staggered approach during a run-in phase feasibility is assessed in 3 (or, if necessary, more) adult patients before initiating recruitment in adolescents.

label: explicit_diagnosis_compatible
rationale: Prospective Cohort 1 explicitly names DSRCT; Cohort 2 additionally permits recurrent extracranial solid tumors of any histology in second complete remission. This is maintenance scope after standard treatment, not an unrestricted active-progression study.
cohort_reconciliation: The treatment arm contains both prospective cohorts; historical matched controls are not a current therapeutic enrollment route. Eligibility permits complete remission or minimal radiological abnormalities, whereas the arm/design descriptions summarize complete remission; preserve the more detailed eligibility and the summary discrepancy.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No additional tumor molecular inclusion gate is stated. Histologic verification is required.
protocol_uncertainty: Ages 1–30, remission/minimal-imaging state and prior-therapy completion conditions remain applicable. Enrollment on another upfront/relapse trial is excluded. External protocol and live cohort availability are unverified; no maintenance efficacy is inferred from the objective.
quotes: Metastatic/unresectable osteosarcoma, metastatic Ewing or Ewing-like sarcoma, high-risk rhabdomyosarcoma, metastatic non-rhabdomyosarcoma soft tissue sarcoma, desmoplastic small round cell tumor (DSRCT), malignant rhabdoid tumor.
Prospective Cohort 2: Recurrent extracranial solid tumor (any histology) in second complete remission following completion of initial relapse regimen.
Subjects must be in complete remission or with minimal radiological abnormalities.

label: explicit_exclusion
rationale: The eligibility expressly lists DSRCT among excluded soft-tissue sarcoma subtypes. The broad retroperitoneal STS inclusion does not override it.
cohort_reconciliation: Both phase I dose finding and phase II radiation efficacy use the same P-SFRT/standard-radiation/surgery pathway. No alternative DSRCT-compatible cohort is stated.
extra_biomarker_requirement: No molecular gate or exception alters the express disease exclusion.
protocol_uncertainty: External protocol and live status are unverified. The source's description of standard-of-care is recorded as the registry's rationale, not independently endorsed. No patient eligibility or radiation benefit conclusion is drawn.
